notes: mc RATES prefetch FRED DGS10 4.98% (2026-10-29) and Damodaran implied ERP 4.20% (1 Oct 2026, the latest monthly update on or before 2026-11-01) kept unchanged. Press says the hot 14 Oct CPI lifted yields (hypothesis, secondary press) [mc_press_gartner].

mc GEOGRAPHY revenue by customer location FY2025 (20-F note 15): US 340.1 (64.2% of 529.8), UK 137.5 (26.0%), rest of world 52.2 (9.9%); FY2024 US 41.1 of 91.5 (44.9%). Netherlands revenue not material. Revenue is customer-located and the customer base is US-concentrated [pf_10k_20260430].

mc GEOGRAPHY long-lived assets 31 Dec 2025 (by country of the owning subsidiary): US 2994.0 (46.1% of 6491.8), Netherlands 2558.8 (39.4%), Israel 281.7 (4.3%), Finland 253.6 (3.9%), rest of world 403.7 (6.2%). Total grew from 896.4 at end-2024. Data centers: Finland owned; New Jersey build-to-suit; colocation in Kansas City, UK, Israel, France, Iceland [pf_10k_20260430].

mc EXPOSURE ISRAEL: 20-F risk factor on hostilities involving the US, Israel and Iran; part of operations, personnel and assets (colocation sites, two more secured Feb 2026) are in or tied to Israel; long-lived assets in Israel 4.3% of total at end-2025 (sized, reported); revenue share not disclosed. Candidate bear mechanism: site disruption sized from 4.3% of assets [pf_10k_20260430, mc_f_lla_il_2025].

mc EXPOSURE EXPORT CONTROLS/BIS: 20-F says management monitors semiconductor export controls on equipment sourcing and a proposed BIS rule on IaaS providers (KYC of foreign-person customers, reporting, authority to restrict IaaS transactions with foreign persons). No revenue share exposed is quantified by the company; non-US customers were about 36% of FY2025 revenue (UK 26%, other 10%), an upper bound of the foreign-customer base, not an evidenced loss. Jan 2026 BIS case-by-case policy for H200-class chips to China carries IaaS KYC conditions [mc_fr_bis_2026, secondary legal summaries]. Hypothesis, unsized: tighter rules raise compliance cost or limit GPU supply [pf_10k_20260430].

mc EXPOSURE TARIFFS/SUPPLY: 20-F risk factor says tariffs, sanctions and export controls may raise cost and cut availability of GPU chips and hardware; suppliers rely on third-party semiconductor chains; some customers contractually specify suppliers. No share of supply by country disclosed (NVIDIA GPUs are the main input per the business section). Hypothesis, unsized [pf_10k_20260430].

mc EXPOSURE RUSSIA/SANCTIONS: all Russia businesses were divested in 2024 (above 95% of then-consolidated revenues); the 20-F states no customers, suppliers or partners in Russia. Residual exposure is reputational/compliance and Russia-linked management history (unsized, hypothesis) [pf_10k_20260430].

mc EXPOSURE ENERGY/POWER: geopolitical conflicts involving energy-producing regions may raise power costs of data centers; Finland and Iceland sites, new US sites. Unsized, hypothesis [pf_10k_20260430].

mc EXPOSURE FINANCING/RATES: 6-K 2026-10-22: new $3.5B senior secured Citi facility, 364-day maturity, Term SOFR + 2.75% rising up to 3.50%, for data center development and GPU procurement; the company cites investment-grade customer commitments above $40B of long-term contracts as the base for asset-backed financing. Short maturity means refinancing risk in a stressed credit market. 2026 capex guide 20-25B (documents lane) against H1 revenue 0.98B [mc_6k_citi].

mc EXPOSURE CUSTOMER CONCENTRATION: documents lane records three unnamed customers at 24%, 21% and 14% of Q2 2026 revenue; the 20-F names Microsoft and Meta as long-term contracts (Meta about 12B over five years from early 2027, plus up to 15B more capacity). This lane does not size it further; see gather_documents [pf_10k_20260430].

mc NEWS 2026-08-19 proposed private offering of $4.50B convertible notes (2030 and 2034 series) with concurrent exchanges of part of the 2029 and 2031 convertibles into Class A shares: dilution and hedge-selling pressure flagged by the company itself [mc_6k_conv_launch].

mc NEWS 2026-09-30 AIB Data Centers announced a binding 12-year, 50 MW capacity contract with Nebius at a southeastern US site; terms not disclosed; AIB funds part through advance payments from Nebius, project borrowing and preferred equity (counterparty press release, a lead; not confirmed at Nebius source) [mc_press_aib].
mc NEWS 2026-10-01 Nebius acquired Inferize (inference optimization, founded Jan 2026) into Token Factory; terms not disclosed [mc_6k_inferize].

mc NEWS 2026-10-14 Gartner said more than 80% of neocloud providers may stop operating independently by 2030 (press frames as consolidation, not only failure); CoreWeave bonds sold off (reported about 15% yield, CDS above 1,000 bps) and neocloud equities fell, NBIS down about 4% on 15 Oct. Secondary press, figures vary by outlet; a lead, the Gartner report itself not read [mc_press_gartner, mc_press_neocloud].

mc NEWS 2026-10-21 public live GPU spot pricing with reserve auctions and pay-as-you-go launched; AI Builder Program grants extended by 10M; shares rose nearly 3% pre-market (secondary press) [mc_press_spot].
mc NEWS 2026-10-22 $3.5B Citi senior secured facility (see EXPOSURE FINANCING/RATES) [mc_6k_citi].

mc NEWS 2026-10-29/30 Microsoft and Google spending missed expectations in press accounts; NBIS fell nearly 11% to a $153.35 close on 2026-10-30 in a broad tech selloff, and about 26% over the month (secondary press, price is gather_numbers' job via IBKR) [mc_press_fool_1030, mc_press_gurufocus_drop].

mc NEWS 2026-10-30 company announced Q3 2026 results for Thursday 2026-11-12 before the open, call 8:00 ET: no Q3 results exist at as_of; the next results are about 11 days away, so the analyst should treat the date as an event risk [mc_ir_q3date].
